predecessors.name: Chagatai Khanate
predecessors.text: the eastern half of the Moghul khanate: 'in the east Esen Buqa's son Dost Muhammad became khan'

successors.name: Moghulistan
successors.text: the Tarim Basin and Turfan joined to the western khanate by Yunus Khan

ledger.x: 1469: Dost Muhammad dies and Yunus Khan reunites the khanate.

wars.name: Moghul succession war after Esen Buqa II (1462-1469)
wars.outcome: The khanate divided in 1462 between Dost Muhammad in the east and Yunus Khan in the west; Dost died in 1468 or 1469 and Yunus reunited the khanate, seizing Aksu.

certainty.note: Oasis polity of the Tarim and Turfan; no page gives a frontier.
